opportunities.title: Regular Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must complete the eligibility quiz on the website to confirm eligibility; open to UK registered charities, CIOs, exempt and excepted charities with at least one year of audited or examined accounts. No specific income threshold for regular grants.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for operating/core costs, capital projects and specific activity projects. Grants are typically 10‑20% of an organisation’s annual budget (operating) or 10‑20% of project/capital costs (up to £30,000 for local community projects).

opportunities.title: Major Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must complete the eligibility quiz. For major grants, either the organisation’s annual income must be at least £1 million (core cost grants) or the total cost of the capital or project must be at least £1 million.
opportunities.summary: Major grants (£100,000+) support operating/core costs, capital projects or specific activity projects for organisations with sufficient scale. Applications are reviewed at eight Board meetings per year.
